name: ExLlamaV2
tagline: High-speed local inference library for quantized EXL2 language models on NVIDIA GPUs.
real_test_summary: Tested running 4-bit EXL2 quantized models locally with variable bit-rate quantization and paged KV cache. Delivers fast token generation on consumer NVIDIA GPUs.
pros: Flexible bit-per-weight quantization preserves quality in tight VRAM
Fast single-stream inference and quantized KV cache on CUDA GPUs
MIT open-source license with active quantization tooling
cons: Focused on NVIDIA CUDA rather than CPU or macOS Metal
Often paired with TabbyAPI or a frontend UI rather than used standalone
